claims.text: The experiments are conducted on the IWSLT14 German-to-English and WMT14 English-to-German tasks.
For the IWSLT14 task, the initial learning rate is set to $5e^{-4}$ and decayed at the 8th epoch.
The WMT14 task experiments use two different initial learning rates of $7e^{-4}$ and $1.5e^{-3}$, both decayed at the 6th epoch.
The experiments utilize a learning rate warm-up stage and an inverse square root learning rate scheduler.
